## Test quality
Not measured this run (`--no-quality` not passed, but mutation/assert-density/AAA/perf sweeps were skipped to keep this a fast prerelease-gate check scoped to the release diff, which contains no new production logic to protect).

## Note on local test failures
`go test ./internal/service` reproducibly fails locally (`TestNoteDeleteAndTrashRestoreKeepSidecarConsistent`, `TestNoteMoveRemovesStaleIndexEntry`, `TestRoundtrip`) with search-index cross-test pollution symptoms (stale/extra hits from other tests' temp dirs). This reproduces identically on `main` before this release's changes, and GitHub Actions CI (both `ubuntu-latest` and `macos-latest`, fresh runners) passes cleanly for the same HEAD (`c8850fc`) — confirmed via `gh api .../check-runs` and `gh run watch`. This is a local-environment-only flake (likely shared global test state across parallel package runs on this machine), not a real regression, and does not affect the coverage numbers above (the affected packages still report their statement counts).

## Findings
No issue-worthy findings. The release diff since v0.6.9 is CI/version-injection plus two test files that only add coverage; overall coverage improved (+1.5%) and there is no regression. Overall statement coverage (72.1%) sits below the informal 80% default bar, but that is pre-existing repo-wide state, not something introduced by this release, and there is no repo-configured hard gate to fail against.

## Non-issues
- `SymDesk.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` is generated (via `xcodegen`) and not itself test-relevant.

## Next step
No action required for this release. If the team wants to close the pre-existing overall-coverage gap, run `/02-gh-plan --from-coverage` against a full (non-baseline-scoped) `/test-coverage` run in a normal iteration, not as part of this release gate.
